topics.label: Course Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the cancer biology lecture series, its overarching themes, and the specific learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Cancer as a Failure of Cellular Differentiation and Tissue Architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define cancer development as a multi-step breakdown of normal cellular differentiation and three-dimensional tissue organization, alongside the experimental models used to study it.

topics.label: Invasion, Metastasis, and the Progression from Benign to Malignant Tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics contrast benign and malignant tumors by detailing the biological and histological processes of local tissue invasion, metastatic dissemination, and stepwise malignant transformation.

topics.label: Neoplasm Nomenclature and Classification
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the standard naming conventions and clinical exceptions used to classify benign and malignant tumors by tissue of origin.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the mechanical, systemic, and organ-level mechanisms by which localized and metastatic tumors cause illness and death.

topics.label: Cancer Incidence in Humans and Other Animal Taxa
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics compare patterns of cancer incidence and mortality across different human tissue types and multicellular animal species.

topics.label: Clinical Detection and Cancer Screening Methods
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the clinical rationale for early cancer detection and compare the implementation and efficacy of screening methods across various organ sites.

topics.label: Conclusion and Next Steps
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a review of the learning outcomes and administrative remarks about upcoming practicals and lectures.
